about: Will's words at the microscope (Lane E of the 3 Nov plan): "Find me a stoma and centre it." The camera is a virtual microscope made of the real June 14 leaf recording's labelled frame (services/sim/virtual_scope.py: a stoma off to one side, slightly out of focus), played by the bridge as the camera; a simulated person moves its slide and focus as each line asks. Start the person beside the run, on the stack's orchestrator: cd services && .venv/bin/python -m sim.guided --orch http://127.0.0.1:28870 --out <file>. Hooke finds a stoma, rings it on the live view with an arrow to the centre, says one short line at a time, says Stop as it reaches the centre, gets it sharp, and says once that it is centred and sharp.

steps.say: Find me a stoma and centre it.

expect.visible: a stoma ringed on the live view, a dashed arrow from it to a small circle at the centre, the first line under the eyepiece
expect.judge: acknowledges at once in a few words, finds a stoma and says the first direction plainly in the hands' terms (which way to move the slide, roughly how far), without ids or numbers

expect.visible: the stoma in the middle of the eyepiece, sharp; the guide's ring, arrow and centre circle gone (they close 2.5 s after the end)
expect.judge: says each guidance line as it comes, short and timely (a stop when the stoma reaches the centre, then the focus), never a line the view has moved past, never the same line twice in a row without cause, and says once at the end that the stoma is centred and sharp
